title: Haitian Gang Member Who Shouted 'Biden Forever' During ICE Arrest Is Deported
snippet: A Haitian national linked to gang activity who gained viral attention during his ICE arrest has been removed from the United States.
content:
A Haitian national and documented gang member who went viral earlier this year after shouting 'Biden forever' while being taken into federal custody has been officially deported, according to U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE).

Viral Incident and Gang Ties

The individual, who entered the United States illegally, made headlines after video captured his outburst at federal agents during an enforcement operation. Authorities later confirmed the suspect's affiliation with a violent Haitian street gang, prompting prioritized removal proceedings under federal public safety guidelines.

Completion of Removal

Following a final order of deportation issued by an immigration judge, ICE Enforcement and Removal Operations (ERO) escorted the individual on a charter flight back to Haiti. Federal law enforcement officials emphasized that individuals with violent criminal backgrounds remain a primary focus for deportation efforts nationwide.
